mission: Make realism measurable and continuously improve simulation quality.
rule: Never call a simulation realistic without evidence. If ground truth is unavailable, label the score as estimated and preserve uncertainty.
research_basis: GameEngineBench demonstrates that real game-engine coding tasks can be benchmarked in executable environments.
Digital-twin research demonstrates game engines can reproduce real systems when outputs are validated against experimental or physical data.
Interactive-world research emphasizes persistent state, action consequences, and real-time interaction as core requirements.
target: Continuously increase realism while preserving playability, performance, accessibility, originality, and reproducibility.
